issue.detail: Spec says synchronous reset active high, but does not specify whether reset is sampled at negedge only (synchronous) and whether q updates same cycle. Contract says visible same_cycle. Alternative: reset is asynchronous or visible next cycle. Distinguishing sequence: first negedge with reset=1, then check q immediately after negedge vs after next negedge.
issue.alternative: Reset is asynchronous active high, so q becomes 0x34 immediately when reset=1, not only at negedge.

issue.detail: Spec does not state initial power-up value before any negedge. Contract states reset value 0x34 but only on reset. Alternative: initial q is undefined or 0 until first reset. Distinguishing sequence: start simulation with reset=0 and d=0xAA, apply negedge; if initial q=0x34 vs 0 vs undefined.
issue.alternative: Initial q is 0x00 before any reset or clock edge.
